requirements.desc: `senti presets list` uses project-aware preset inventory when run from a project root, so enabled plugin presets are included with core presets.
requirements.note: R1: reads enabled project plugin presets in presets list

requirements.desc: A project with installed official-presets displays the multi-level chain containing `base`, `webapp`, `js-webapp`, and `nextjs` in the tree output.
requirements.note: R2: renders nextjs under js-webapp under webapp

requirements.desc: When no plugin registry is available, or registry loading fails in non-strict inspection mode, `senti presets list` still displays the existing base-only tree output instead of failing.
requirements.note: R3: keeps base-only fallback when no plugin registry is available

requirements.desc: The command preserves retained public output formatting: root line format, branch connectors, preset labels, aliases, scan markers, template availability marker, child alphabetical ordering, and missing-base fallback behavior.
The change does not modify setup candidate resolution, preset chain resolution semantics, plugin installation, or official-presets package contents.
requirements.note: R5: leaves setup candidate and resolver ownership outside presets list

requirements.desc: `senti presets list` bounds preset inventory and tree traversal by processing at most 512 preset entries, rendering at most depth 16, and preventing cycle traversal with visited preset keys.
requirements.note: R6: bounds renderer preset count, depth, and cycles
